Name: (CP) Vanillaish Lewis (Genderbend Lewis)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits of your genderbend elegant mayoress, Lewis, vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Currently there is no matching sprites yet, I'll draw her sprites if I have more free time (you know me).

[b]INSTRUCTION:[/b]
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Lewis into your mod folder.
﻿- In configuration, choose between two version: Glasses or NoGlasses (or type "Glasses", "NoGlasses" under LewisGlasses in the config.json file).

[b]COMPATIBILITY:[/b]
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿- Other mod that change Lewis portraits: depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Lewis changes in those mod.

[b]PERMISSIONS[/b]: As always, I don't block any of my mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want. 

[b]CREDITS:[/b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] for inspiration.
